name: WORLD_CORE_V15_V16_FOUNDATION_REVIEWED_NONPRODUCTION

independent_review.scope: V15-V16 package-scoped pure Core social foundation remediation candidate only
independent_review.limit: This is not approval of a V15 or V16 product, Gate, hard-dependency path, merge, deployment, or production action.

review_remediation: Canonical source/predecessor, lineage, version, snapshot, time, and payload binding prevents mixed or stale social-foundation inputs.
Housing stock can increase only through an explicitly commissioned Project handoff; subsidies remain inert observed inputs.
Education, healthcare, safety, and emergency-authority calculations preserve their stated capacity, personnel, unit, and expiry boundaries.

final_foundation_integration.scope: Accepted only as a reviewed non-production input to the separately governed final V11-V18 pure-Core foundation integration.
conditions: A later integration change must preserve the exact source provenance, including the 5eb535e parent and b84e790 remediation tip, and re-run combined integration checks.
The V09 quarantine and all Core boundary restrictions remain in force.
This acceptance does not satisfy, bypass, or reclassify any R2 normal-mode dependency.

hard_dependencies.effect: Unchanged. This policy does not approve, satisfy, bypass, or reclassify any dependency.

preserved_boundaries: V15 and V16 remain FOUNDATION_REVIEWED_NONPRODUCTION, not VERIFIED.
No V15 or V16 product integration, Gate readiness, lifecycle-state transition, or dependency-path approval is claimed.
No status/progress or Gate record is changed.
No database, RLS, migration, API, worker, UI, Command, Event, authoritative state, transaction, production, merge, or deployment action is authorized.
No education, healthcare, housing, safety, rent, subsidy, dispatch, authority, population, labour, or macro-policy formula is selected.
V09.3 remains the owner of durable atomic commit, idempotency, writer coordination, and recovery evidence.
